budget.label: Budget
budget.note: The cap is advisory: nothing pauses Full Auto or the night runs automatically. The per-night-run cap, on the other hand, does stop the following waves.

pipeline.heading: Autonomous Pipeline
pipeline.label: Pipeline
pipeline.meta: chains a review onto every build — a green run leaves the ticket in Review, it never approves
pipeline.enabledSuffix: · each dispatch can still force it
pipeline.maxAttemptsNote: how many times a failed build, fix or review is retried before giving up ({min}–{max})
pipeline.maxFixCyclesNote: how many times blocking findings send the ticket back to a fix agent ({min}–{max}; 0 reports the findings without fixing them)

verification.heading: Deterministic verification
verification.label: Verification
verification.meta: run in the worktree after a successful build — an empty array disables the stage
verification.regressionGate: Mandatory regression test on bug tickets
verification.regressionGateSuffix: · red before the fix, green after
verification.regressionCommandNote: run on the branch then on the merge-base · {placeholder} is replaced with the detected tests (default {default})
verification.testFilePatternsNote: comma-separated globs, applied to the branch diff (default {default})

agentsMemory.heading: Agents and memory
agentsMemory.label: Agents & memory
agentsMemory.meta: what an agent session receives, and what it leaves behind
agentsMemory.mcpToolsNote: read its ticket, comment, change the status, ask a blocking question, file a finding — with no prose conventions. Off: new sessions start without the channel, running sessions do not move.
agentsMemory.memoryDistill: Distil the memory after a successful build
agentsMemory.memoryDistillNote: a distillation agent merges the new conventions into the project memory, which is then injected into every prompt. Off by default.
agentsMemory.specRewrite: Rewrite the spec after every release
agentsMemory.specRewriteNote: when a release is published, a plan-mode agent rewrites the specification to match what actually shipped. Skipped during a manual update. Off by default.
